data.content_ref: inline:SRC_009 (claiming $1,269) DEPENDS ON the causal mechanism of SRC_012/SRC_007: the $1,269 total is the incorrect output of the standard piecewise overtime calculation when the overtime rate ($27) is misapplied to ALL 47 hours instead of only the 7 overtime hours. This is a scope-error dependence: the correct mechanism's overtime function is causally inherited but its domain is over-extended from {hours > 40} to {all hours}. REFUTED IF: the $1,269 total results from a globally uniform premium contract (1.5× for all hours) rather than from the misapplication of a piecewise standard to all hours, or if the standard mechanism itself intrinsically mandates $1,269.
